children: Oaktree Specialty Lending entered into an underwriting agreement to issue $300.0 million of 7.000% notes due 2031. The transaction is expected to close on September 16, 2026, with net proceeds of approximately $296.5 million after a $2.6 million underwriting discount and about $0.8 million of expenses. The notes are being offered off an effective shelf registration and are intended to support liquidity and general corporate purposes.
: Underwriting agreement for $300 million 7.000% notes due 2031
: J.P. Morgan Securities, BNP Paribas Securities, ING Financial Markets, RBC Capital Markets, SMBC Nikko Securities America, as representatives of the underwriters
